verdicts.reason: A puts a dense legal block first at the far left, so the reading order is wrong and the fine print competes with the message. Its subhead wraps and leaves '100 m.' orphaned, and the tiny logo is wedged in beside the subhead. B reads cleanly left to right (watch, headline, price, CTA) with the subhead on one line, but the watch is cropped off the left edge, the subhead sits close to the bottom edge, and the legal text is squeezed into an illegible strip under the CTA, with the logo nearly invisible next to it.
